summary: Narrow lane signed no stopping and no parking, with homes 8-10 m away.

drivers.seclusion: Apartments 8 m and a house 10 m from the kerb; homes on both sides.
drivers.access_and_room: Single narrow lane with trees and hedges to the edge; no pull-off.
drivers.traffic: Quiet lane, but residents' cars pass close by.
drivers.convention: No Stopping and No Parking signs; cars squeeze in at the edges only.

sun_shade: Dense tree canopy over the west side.
